title: azorella pallida
intro: Azorella pallida, commonly known as Anceuche, is a small, low-growing, succulent plant native to the Andes mountains in South America. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating digestive issues and reducing inflammation. The health benefits of Azorella pallida include its ability to soothe digestive issues such as diarrhea and stomach pain, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Azorella pallida include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
